title: Factor finite compact pieces through cone blocks
statement: For a finite-piece diagram D [lem-sc-compact-flat-finite-subcomplex-diagrams], any map from one piece D(j) into the cone telescope [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] factors through a finite cone block C_n [def-sc-compact-flat-telescope-blocks].

source.place: The source-bar, finite-cone-block, least-block adjunction and union-bar paragraphs; Factor finite compact pieces through cone blocks.

proof.text: Decompose each cone term as the biproduct of two countable coproduct terms. The piece term is a finite coproduct of coproduct-compact generators, so each of its component maps has finite support. Lift the countable index to the required universe and bound these supports to obtain a factorization in each degree. There are finitely many potentially nonzero degrees of D(j), so take a maximum of their bounds and pass to that block. In every other degree use zero. The block inclusion is monic in each term because its finite-sum inclusions split, so cancellation of that inclusion proves the factor maps commute with differentials. Termwise cancellation also proves the factorization of cochain maps.
